mode has 40 waves. It is named after snow and frost-themed enemies in said mode.

Cash is only gained if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained is a set amount of cash, which is not always equal to the enemy's health. It uses a slightly different method of distributing cash between players, as enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player does all the damage to an enemy, both players will receive 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This means that in solo, you receive 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it is damaged enough. With each additional player, this is reduced to 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. If it is a decimal, it gets rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it is at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it is less than 0.5, it gets rounded down.
The health of enemies in this mode scales with the player count, starting at two players. The increase 30% in duo, 45% in trio and 60% in quad. It is applied after attributes, like

Heads up Commander. We've tracked unusual activity nearby and the temperature is plummeting.
Also...V seems a bit too exited about it, so I'd take that as a warning sign.
I've been tracking these anomalies for weeks! Creatures have been coming out of these random pockets of frost and I just have to know where they're coming from!
Hey V, what do we know about these things so far?
Hacker sent some drones into the frost so it'll be some time until we know more. I can't wait!
I'm not liking what I'm seeing. Commander, it might be time to set up some hidden detection!
That's incredible! Those Cold Mists are using droplets of water to refract the light and make themselves nearly invisible!
I meant to ask. How do we know the names of these things anyway?
The research team has a dart board and they just kinda'-*click*.
Is that a Frost Mystery?! It's been years since we've seen one! You just HAVE to bring one back for me!
So you can do what you did to that other creature? No way!
You really suck the fun out of research, don't you?
If I knew they were frost enemies, I would have brought Pyro. These snowballs keep stunning us!
Have you tried, I don't know... ducking?
So that's what they were. I knew I saw something flying over a building in the photos! Why do they seem so...sad?
We've finally got something back from Hacker. It's not much, but we did learn a few things.
In the few pictures we transmitted, it shows a massive city carved completely out of ice and stone. Primitive by our standards, but the designs are impressive!
We've trying to see what they're using to connect to our realm, but it's so cold there that the drones are freezing in only a few seconds. I'll let you know if we find out more.
Does it seem like fighting with strategy? That would mean something is commanding them.
It's a bit hard to think when you are shooting something you can barely see!
Hey, uh... I see something crawling out of the frost.
It might be a good idea to start building up our defenses a bit more.
I am freezing-I can barely feel my fingers! The more of these things that show up, the colder it gets!
I'm starting to think we should have brought Freezer instead. I bet he'd feel right at home-and won't complain too much.
That's easy to say when you're not the one out here!
Heads up! Looks like you have something coming.
'Something' is putting it lightly. Those Frost Hunters are terrifying!
some Frost Ravagers coming! Take out their shields!
...and collect the pieces! I want to study what they're made out of!
I think I'm going to send you into the field next time since you want to research everything.
V, have you learned anything else about the Frost Realm?

Aside from chains hanging everywhere? It seems like a structured society. The portal also leads into a militarized area, but in the back of this image there's something flying. I'm not sure what it is.

We need to prepare for whatever might come out from that opening. The scientists have confirmed that it functions like our own portals, only differences is that something on the other side is holding it open, Maybe it could be that?
They look like they're built to be front liners! I bet their job is to make an opening so they can kill us! How cool!
I need to stop doing that!
Those are a lot bigger than I remember!
I wonder how they got like that? They must be absorbing whatever is in their realm to cause such large mutations!
Please...I can't handle any more scientific theories...
I don't want to alarm you, but the last drone that went in showed a lot of enemies heading towards the portal.
Watch out Commander, this would be the best time to upgrade everything we have!
I hope whatever that thing was comes through!
Those Tricksters are buffing the Frost Army!
Those Tricksters are buffing the Frost Army!
They're starting to send out stronger units. I have a bad feeling about this.
Hold out for as long as you can! There's so much to study!
I've spotted a Frost Necromancer!...and a Frost Hero?!
They're starting to send out stronger units. I have a bad feeling about this.
Hold out for as long as you can! There's so much to study!
They have to be those guards that I saw surrounding the creature! It's almost here!
I wonder if those creatures are tied to it in some way. What if they're enslaved to serve? What if they devote their existence to it? I have so many questions!
V you're giving me villain vibes!
A large enemy exited the frost portal and the temperature is dropping! You need to get out of there!
This data is incredible! I've never seen anything like it! This could revolutionize so many things! I'd study it more if I wouldn't freeze to death.
We're giving it everything we've got! We can't let this thing stay in our realm!
